title: Add RecipeCatalog derived filter value collections
description: Expose catalog-derived collections needed by the filter UI: normalized tag corpus ordered by frequency, plus unique sorted difficulty and course values. Add a flat iteration helper only if the current catalog shape needs one for efficient derivation.
acceptance_criteria: `RecipeCatalog` exposes `tagCorpus` as the union of normalized tags sorted by descending frequency then alphabetically.
Derived values recalculate from the current in-memory catalog contents after reload without adding duplicate stored state.

handoff_summary.completed: Added to RecipeCatalog.swift: private `allEntries: [RecipeEntry]` (flat iteration helper), `tagCorpus: [String]` (normalized tags by descending frequency then alpha), `difficultyValues: [String]` (unique alpha from metadata["difficulty"]), `courseValues: [String]` (unique alpha from metadata["meal type"] ?? metadata["meal_type"]). xcodebuild BUILD SUCCEEDED.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. All properties are pure computed derivations with no stored state drift risk.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to verify derived collections return correct values against a fixture catalog.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — changes are additive (new computed properties only) with no modifications to existing API surface.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used computed properties (not stored) so values always reflect the current in-memory catalog without needing an explicit invalidation step. Private `allEntries` helper avoids triple `sections.flatMap` in the three derived properties. `courseValues` reads both `"meal type"` and `"meal_type"` keys, matching the existing pattern in RecipeStatStrip.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should verify: tagCorpus ordering (frequency desc, alpha tiebreak), deduplication in difficultyValues/courseValues, both "meal type" and "meal_type" keys fold into courseValues, empty catalog returns empty arrays, values update after catalog reload.

conflict_risks: None — changes are additive (new computed properties only) with no modifications to existing API surface.

execution_history.summary: Added `tagCorpus`, `difficultyValues`, and `courseValues` computed properties to `RecipeCatalog`, plus a private `allEntries` flat-iteration helper. All three derive directly from `sections` with no stored state, so they automatically re-derive after every catalog reload. Build succeeded.
